source_book: Modern GPU Programming For MLSys (MLC Community) + NVIDIA Blackwell Tuning/Compatibility Guides

test_cases.prompt: Design a B200 2-CTA cluster GEMM and explain the DSMEM and barrier mask.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and output the cluster tile, owners, DSMEM, occupancy, and handoff.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the activation boundary and execution method; does not imply this has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Tail tile costs are uneven; I want to use CLC for work stealing.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and give the try-cancel/query/predicate protocol.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the activation boundary and execution method; does not imply this has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Can cluster size 16 be used? How do I enable it safely?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should activate and explain the opt-in, occupancy, and fallback.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the activation boundary and execution method; does not imply this has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: A tiny elementwise kernel with only one CTA each time.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate; cluster/persistent is very likely unsuitable.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the activation boundary and execution method; does not imply this has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: How do I configure a multi-node NCCL communication topology?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Should not activate; this is cross-node communication.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the activation boundary and execution method; does not imply this has been run on B200 hardware.

test_cases.prompt: Tiles are uniform, but the grid's tail count is not divisible by the SM count.
test_cases.expected_behavior: May evaluate persistent/CLC; whether it is worth it depends on the tail fraction and the scheduling overhead.
test_cases.notes: Used to validate the activation boundary and execution method; does not imply this has been run on B200 hardware.

notes: All should_not_trigger cases must pass; edge_case must state the invocation boundary. These are prompt/behavior stress tests, not hardware performance tests.
